# Vietlott Data

> Open, daily-updated dataset of every Vietlott (Vietnam) lottery draw result: Power 6/55, Mega 6/45, Power 5/35, Keno, Max 3D, Max 3D Pro and Bingo18. Crawled from the official vietlott.vn, stored as NDJSON, MIT licensed. Bộ dữ liệu mở kết quả xổ số Vietlott đầy đủ từ kỳ quay đầu tiên, cập nhật hàng ngày.

Each line is one draw: `{"date":"2026-10-06","id":"01407","result":[6,7,18,20,24,27,1],"process_time":"..."}`. For Power 6/55 / Mega 6/45 / Power 5/35 the last number of `result` is the special/bonus number. Data is for education and statistics only; lottery draws are random and not predictable.

## Data files (raw NDJSON)
- [Power 6/55](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/main/data/power655.jsonl): Vietlott Power 6/55 results since 2017-08-01
- [Mega 6/45](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/main/data/power645.jsonl): Vietlott Mega 6/45 results
- [Power 5/35](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/main/data/power535.jsonl): Vietlott Power 5/35 results
- [Keno](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/main/data/keno.jsonl): Vietlott Keno results
- [Max 3D](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/main/data/3d.jsonl): Vietlott Max 3D results
- [Max 3D Pro](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/main/data/3d_pro.jsonl): Vietlott Max 3D Pro results
- [Bingo18](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vietvudanh/vietlott-data/main/data/bingo18.jsonl): Vietlott Bingo18 results
